limitations: Static review confirms the previous budget finding is resolved. Each phase uses one monotonic timestamp to check its deadline and calculate elapsed time before publishing its result. Assessment receives the unused portion of the 600-second allowance, and the per-arm result and summary use the same checked total.

The four K2 forwards implement the specified score mixtures, and the independent fixture recomputes logits using component masses. K1 delegates to the native head. At seed 13, the factory preserves the native initialization and adds 480 parameters per K2 arm using seed 9200. The reload factory reconstructs the same parameter names and shapes.

The legacy defaults retain FP64, the original callbacks, and the two-argument fixture call. The supplied profile selects FP32 and the dense callbacks, and passes the real fit[:8] labels to fixtures that update deep copies. The dense callback bodies were unavailable for inspection, and no GPU run was performed. Mean-CE reduction, measured fixture errors, and checkpoint reload therefore remain unverified at runtime.
